message:
fix(daemon): recover sqlite SELECT failures without killing listen-ready (#2999)

* fix(daemon): keep listen-ready when sqlite fails after open

Recover fatal SQLite errors on later SELECTs, not only connect, and
fail open on AIBOM persist and first-cloud-sync so Desktop is not
killed by a store that still looks schema-current.

Signed-off-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(daemon): keep sqlite recovery diagnostics and isolate persist

Preserve the triggering SQLite error when recovery itself fails, move AIBOM persist off the daemon server module, and keep first-sync sqlite coverage in the recovery tests.

Signed-off-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>

* fix(store): keep current schema through transient sqlite IO

Do not abort GuardStore construction when recovery declines a cleared disk I/O error and the schema is already current. Sort daemon imports for ruff.

Signed-off-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>

* style(store): format sqlite init recovery condition

Keep ruff format happy on the transient-IO construction path.

Signed-off-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>

---------

Signed-off-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: ZCF <291624129+zerocodefast@users.noreply.github.com>
